prs.title: 新增 scan：相邻两元素求和取最大

--- /dev/null
+++ b/agent/scan.py
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+"""扫描相邻对。"""
+
+
+def adjacent_max(items):
+    best = 0
+    for i in range(len(items)):
+        best = max(best, items[i] + items[i + 1])
+    return best

bugs.desc: i 取到 len-1 时 items[i+1] 越界

prs.title: 新增 safe_div：带判空的除法与均值
prs.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/agent/safe_div.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+"""安全除法。"""
+
+
+def ratio(a, b):
+    if b == 0:
+        raise ValueError("b must be non-zero")
+    return a / b
+
+
+def mean(nums):
+    if not nums:
+        raise ValueError("mean of empty sequence")
+    return sum(nums) / len(nums)

prs.title: 新增 export：把行写到文件
prs.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/agent/export.py
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+"""导出。"""
+
+
+def export(path, rows):
+    out = open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8")
+    for row in rows:
+        if row == None:
+            continue
+        out.write(str(row) + "\n")

bugs.desc: open 没配 with，异常时文件不关也不 flush
